chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-16

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-16 How could you use 1H NMR to determine the regiochemistry of electrophilic addition to alkenes? For example, does addition of HCl to 1-methylcyclohexene yield 1-chloro-1-methylcyclohexane or 1-chloro-2-methylcyclohexane?
